scope: analysis round: where the renderer gets its camera, and why the field loop cannot end cleanly

findings.cl_snap_is_not_the_camera_source: writing angles/origin at cl+0x3B7C+0x20/0x30 changed nothing, so the renderer reads a different structure (likely a refdef/cg snapshot copy)
findings.field_loop_terminator: 0x471D80 keeps looping while the stream error flag at [edx] is zero; the only way it stops is reading past length, which sets the error flag and makes 0x471D80 return 1
findings.why_state_9: with error set, the following blocks (playerState, actor) read from an already-exhausted stream, so the snapshot never promotes to state 10

next: locate the renderer camera input: search for the code that writes vieworg/viewangles into a refdef-like global before R_RenderScene
or find cg.snap (the game copy) rather than cl.snap, and inject there as a diagnostic
protocol side: determine the entityState field count so the field stream can end exactly at length
